C45078.observed: What was checked: whether opening an existing part to look at it, and then closing it or walking away, is treated as unsaved work. What happened: the edit row was opened on an existing part and nothing was altered. Closing it with the row's close control shut it straight away with no question asked; and on a second run, leaving the work order by clicking "Schedule" in the top menu went through immediately, again with no question. Looking at a part without changing it costs the user nothing.
